cards.x: Tiny but everywhere. It can mean "from", "of" or "some of": مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ = of the believers.
The most frequent word in the Quran. Often follows a connecting word: بِاللَّهِ = in/by Allah, لِلَّهِ = for/belongs to Allah.
Two jobs: "what / that which" (مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ = what is in the earth) and "not" (مَا هَٰذَا بَشَرًا = this is not a human).
Before a verb it can mean "do not!" (a command) or just "not". لَا إِلَٰهَ = there is no god.
فِيهَا = in it (f.), فِيهِ = in it (m.), فِيهِمْ = among them.
Adds emphasis and is often left out in English. Pronouns stick to it: إِنَّهُ (indeed he), إِنَّا (indeed we), إِنَّكَ (indeed you).
قَالَ he said, قَالُوا they said, قُلْ say!, يَقُولُ he says. Most Quran stories are built on it.
الَّذِينَ = those who. Links a description to a person: الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا = those who believed.
عَلَيْهِمْ = upon them, عَلَيْكُمْ = upon you.

cards.e: he was / it was / used to be
cards.x: Says what someone or something was or used to be. Sometimes invisible in English.
رَبِّي my Lord, رَبُّكَ your Lord, رَبَّنَا our Lord.
Asks "who?" or means "whoever": مَن يَشَاءُ = whoever He wills.
إِلَيْهِ = to Him / to it, إِلَيْكَ = to you.
Mostly "if" (إِن كُنتُمْ = if you are). Occasionally "not".
مَا ... إِلَّا = nothing but / only: مَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ = it is only a reminder.
Links a verb to what came before: أَن يَقُولُوا = that they say.
آمَنُوا they believed, يُؤْمِنُونَ they believe, مُؤْمِن a believer.
يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ = the Day of Resurrection, يَوْمَئِذٍ = on that day.
Away from or about: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ = they ask you about.
السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ = the heavens and the earth.
Starts a situation that will happen: إِذَا جَاءَ = when (it) comes.
Adds certainty or "has already": قَدْ أَفْلَحَ = has indeed succeeded.
يَا قَوْمِ = O my people! (how prophets address their people).
Both a sign of Allah in the world and a verse of the Quran.
يَعْلَمُ he knows, تَعْلَمُونَ you know.
أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ = that Allah is Forgiving.
لَمْ + verb = "did not": لَمْ يَلِدْ = He did not beget.
A longer pause than وَ or فَ.
Often opens a story: وَإِذْ قَالَ = and (remember) when he said.
عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ = over all things.
عَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ = they did righteous deeds.
آتَيْنَاهُمْ We gave them; أُوتُوا were given.
تَرَى you see, يَرَوْا they see.
الْكِتَابُ often means the Quran or earlier scriptures.
يَشَاءُ He wills; لَوْ شَاءَ if He had willed.
يَا أَيُّهَا = O (you)!, as in يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ = O people!
لَوْ شَاءَ = if He had willed (but He didn't).
